conventions.clone_quality: raw clone is highest quality — NO pitch_semitones, NO voice FX

num_step.note: 64 = audibly more inflection/clarity, ~+32% synth time (0.118 -> 0.157 s/char); use only when high quality requested

conventions.loudness: normalize the OUTPUT (ffmpeg loudnorm I=-16 TP=-1.5), NOT the reference — normalizing a quiet ref amplifies its noise floor and clips the clone

gyasi_dia.usage: POST text prefixed with [S3]. Per-request speaker selection (added 2026-06-16) means [S3] uses ONLY this ref. Split long monologues into <=10s chunks + concat — Dia destabilizes past ~10s. temperature up to 2.5 for more emotion; add (sighs)/(shouts) cues inline.
gyasi_dia.post_fx: none (loudnorm I=-16 TP=-1.5 on output only)
gyasi_dia.source: Gyasi's own voice; registered as Dia [S3] canonical slot via DIA_GYASI_REF_* env in io.macstudio.hub.dia.plist.
